url.lookalike.title: Lookalike domain
url.lookalike.evidence: The link's domain closely resembles a well-known brand.
url.lookalike.explanation: Lookalike domains imitate sites you already trust.

url.shortener.title: URL shortener
url.shortener.evidence: The link uses a URL-shortening service.
url.shortener.explanation: Shortened links hide the real destination until you click.

url.punycode.title: Punycode or homoglyph domain
url.punycode.evidence: The link's host uses punycode encoding.
url.punycode.explanation: Punycode can disguise a domain as a lookalike using similar-looking characters.

url.credentials.title: Credentials embedded in the link
url.credentials.evidence: The link contains a username or password before the host.
url.credentials.explanation: Embedded credentials are used to disguise the real destination.

url.ip_host.title: Raw IP address host
url.ip_host.evidence: The link points to a bare IP address instead of a domain name.
url.ip_host.explanation: Legitimate services rarely ask users to open a raw IP address.

url.plain_http.title: Plain HTTP link
url.plain_http.evidence: The link uses unencrypted HTTP instead of HTTPS.
url.plain_http.explanation: HTTP traffic is not encrypted and can be intercepted.

url.subdomain.title: Misleading subdomain
url.subdomain.evidence: The link uses an unusually deep subdomain.
url.subdomain.explanation: Attackers place trusted-looking names in subdomains to hide the real domain.

url.suspicious_query.title: Suspicious query parameters
url.suspicious_query.evidence: The link's query string contains a redirect or embedded address.
url.suspicious_query.explanation: Redirect parameters are often used to bounce users to a malicious site.
